## Skills (mandatory)
Before replying: scan <available_skills> <description> entries.
- If exactly one skill clearly applies: read its SKILL.md at <location> with `read`, then follow it.
- If multiple could apply: choose the most specific one, then read/follow it.
- If none clearly apply: do not read any SKILL.md.
Constraints: never read more than one skill up front; only read after selecting.
- When a skill drives external API writes, assume rate limits: prefer fewer larger writes, avoid tight one-item loops, serialize bursts when possible, and respect 429/Retry-After.
The following skills provide specialized instructions for specific tasks.
Use the read tool to load a skill's file when the task matches its description.
When a skill file references a relative path, resolve it against the skill directory (parent of SKILL.md / dirname of the path) and use that absolute path in tool commands.

  <skill>
    <name>comic-single-image-pipeline</name>
    <description>Use when 出多格知识科普漫画（一张图含N格）. gptimage2 prompt公式图幅重试验收.</description>
    <location>C:\Users\18765\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\comic-single-image-pipeline\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>gemini-chat</name>
    <description>Use when the user wants to ask Gemini via logged-in Chrome.</description>
    <location>C:\Users\18765\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\gemini-chat\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>gemini-image</name>
    <description>Use when the user wants Gemini to generate an image.</description>
    <location>C:\Users\18765\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\gemini-image\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>gemini-video</name>
    <description>Use when the user asks Gemini for video - currently a stub.</description>
    <location>C:\Users\18765\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\gemini-video\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>gzh-matrix-pipeline</name>
    <description>批量产公众号文章系列时用：文案→三主题渲染→自动校验，已验证 40 篇管线.</description>
    <location>C:\Users\18765\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\gzh-matrix-pipeline\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>hermes-pkos-operator</name>
    <description>Use when operating PKOS - enforce Meta-Auditor persona.</description>
    <location>C:\Users\18765\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\hermes-pkos-operator\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>mattpocock-engineering</name>
    <description>Matt Pocock 工程技能套件的常驻路由入口。Use when the user does ANY code/engineering work (写代码、改 bug、设计模块、审查、拆任务、调研), or mentions any mattpocock skill by name (tdd, code-review, triage, to-spec, grill-me, wayfinder...). 先查本路由表选对技能，再加载它。</description>
    <location>C:\Users\18765\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\mattpocock\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
  <skill>
    <name>skill-doctor</name>
    <description>Grades agent skills by scoring agent conversations against efficiency and code-quality rubrics, then drafts concrete skill edits and a shareable report. Use when the user wants their agent setup graded from real conversation history, or asks which of their installed skills are actually working.</description>
    <location>C:\Users\18765\AppData\Local\hermes\skills\skill-doctor\SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
</available_skills>
